scoring_justification: The exact reference values (paper’s fit parameters and digitized M/y) are unavailable; structural trend checks (monotonicity, ordering, asymmetry) directly verify the paper’s reported behaviour without requiring digitized gold numbers.

hidden_assets.purpose: No hidden numerical gold; the checker enforces structural consistency rules derived from the paper’s statements and figures.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.1 (U_eff doping dependence and electron–hole asymmetry), Fig.4(a) (AF order evolution and two-step behaviour), and the text discussions.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Logical constraints extracted from the paper’s conclusions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: No fabricated data; only structural consistency rules.

outputs.description: Doping-dependent effective Hubbard constant Ueff for hole and electron doping, computed from the static screening formula for two bare Hubbard interactions U=5t and 6t.

Layer-resolved antiferromagnetic order parameters, charge imbalance, and layer charge densities for the N-based three-layer cuprate with U=5t and Madelung potential W=1.0t, as functions of average doping δ. The charge densities are required to verify the predicted anomalous increase of minority charge density upon doping.

output_contract.notes: The agent must self-consistently solve the mean-field equations with the screening-corrected Ueff. The checker compares the submitted CSV data against structural consistency rules derived from the paper's reported behaviour (monotonicity, ordering, electron–hole asymmetry, charge density anomaly).

steps.description: Verifies U_eff doping dependence, electron–hole asymmetry, magnitude bounds, and dependence on bare U via structural checks.
Verifies non-negative AF order, M_OP≥M_IP, monotonic decrease, and two-step evolution of M_IP; charge imbalance present.
